name: KudoMetrics IndexNow – Automatic URL Submission to Search Engines
author: kudometricsllc

sections.description:
KudoMetrics IndexNow – Automatic URL Submission to Search Engines submits your published, updated, and deleted URLs to search engines via the open IndexNow protocol. Instead of waiting days or weeks for search engines to crawl your XML sitemap, this plugin notifies participating search engines immediately when your content changes.

What is IndexNow?

IndexNow is a free, open protocol initiated by Microsoft Bing. It allows website owners to instantly notify participating search engines about new, modified, or deleted content. Search engines that adopt the IndexNow protocol share URL updates with each other, ensuring rapid discovery across multiple search engines including Microsoft Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam.cz, and Yep.

Key Features

  • Automated submission on post publish, update, and delete.
  • Automatic verification key generation and virtual serving at yourdomain.com/your-key.txt.
  • Bulk URL submission for existing published posts and pages.
  • Live status tester to test any URL and inspect the HTTP response.
  • Clear submission history log with status indicators.
  • Direct server-to-API requests to the official IndexNow endpoint without intermediary servers.
  • Lightweight PHP implementation with zero external library dependencies.
  • Compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, and WooCommerce.

Privacy & External Services

This plugin connects directly to the official external IndexNow API endpoint using the open IndexNow protocol (https://www.indexnow.org) to notify search engines when pages are published, updated, or deleted.

  • Service Provider: Microsoft Bing / IndexNow
  • Endpoint URL: https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow
  • Data Sent: The URL of the published, updated, or deleted post, host domain name, and the generated IndexNow verification key.
  • IndexNow Terms of Use: https://www.indexnow.org/terms
  • Microsoft Privacy Statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress dashboard, or upload the zip in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Your IndexNow verification key is automatically generated and auto-submission is enabled immediately.
  4. To test, navigate to URL Submission in your admin menu and use the live URL tester.
sections.faq:
What is IndexNow?

IndexNow is a free, open protocol that lets website owners notify search engines immediately whenever content is published, updated, or deleted.

Which search engines are supported?

Participating search engines that support the IndexNow protocol, including Microsoft Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam.cz, and Yep.

Is IndexNow free to use? Do I need an API key?

Yes. The IndexNow protocol is completely free. You do not need to register for an external account. The plugin generates and serves your verification key automatically.

Does IndexNow submit to Google?

No. Google does not participate in the IndexNow protocol. This plugin submits to search engines that support IndexNow, including Microsoft Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam.cz, and Yep.

Do I still need an XML sitemap?

Yes. XML sitemaps remain important for search engines to discover site structure. IndexNow complements your sitemap by communicating real-time content changes.

Does this work with SEO plugins and WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin works seamlessly alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, and WooCommerce.

How quickly does indexing occur?

Search engines receive the submission within seconds. Actual indexing and appearance in search results remain at the sole discretion of each search engine.

1.0.1

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
  • Automated URL submission for participating IndexNow search engines: Microsoft Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam.cz, and Yep.
  • Automated verification key creation and virtual key route handling.
  • Bulk URL submission and manual URL tester.
  • Submission history log with AJAX pagination and clear history action.
  • Compatible with WordPress 5.8 through 7.1 and PHP 7.4 through 8.3+.
